units.statement: Brain2Qwerty employs a three-stage deep learning architecture â convolutional module, sentence-level transformer, and pretrained character-level language model â that synthesizes pre-existing components into a novel approach for decoding language production from noninvasive signals.
source_quotes: Our Brain2Qwerty model includes three core stages to decode text from brain activity: (1) a convolutional module, (2) a transformer module trained at the sentence level and (3) a pretrained language model to correct the outputs of the transformer.
Our Brain2Qwerty model is composed of three successive modules (Fig. 1).

For this, we present Brain2Qwerty, a new deep learning architecture trained to decode sentences from either electro- or magnetoencephalography, while participants typed briefly memorized sentences on a QWERTY keyboard.
